## The problem

What you are trying to do, and what makes it hard or impossible today.

## The change you have in mind

What you would like the library to do. A sketch of the API is welcome and not required.

## Alternatives

Anything you tried or considered, including workarounds.

## Anything else

Which package this concerns, and whether the change would affect existing public types or members.
